canonical_theme: Duckweed colonies and sliding puzzles: eight overlapping leaf plates move around one eye gap; connected root limbs rearrange as the colony solves its path across a pond.
canonical_eye_form: Exactly ONE isolated blacksquare pupil in SOUTH and ONE in WEST, inside single broad LIGHT sclera recess, not2ordinaryeyes. No decorative leafdots.

palette_binding.white_body_region_policy: Simplify formerly white body/highlight regions to light ink1. Index0 is transparent everywhere, not an opaque white paint color.

motion_contract: Four rootpads/two tendrils are canonical plant anatomy, no fish tail; only rootpad tips shift1logicalpixel in secondrow, leaves/eye/headanchor identical.
